research.facts:
CPSC Recalls — Coin Battery Hazards (A2batt + KC Imports)
**Recall announcement date:** August 6, 2026 (part of CPSC's 17-recall batch) — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
**A2batt EEMB Lithium-ion Coin Battery Chargers:**
- Units: Approximately 4,930 — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- Product: EEMB Lithium-ion Coin Battery Chargers, model SKLC-0420-0040 (includes charger, 4 rechargeable CR2032 batteries, USB cable) — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- Sold: Amazon.com, August 2024 – March 2026, approximately $14 — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- Hazard: Coin batteries accessible to children; packaging does not meet child-resistant design standards and lacks required warnings under Reese's Law; swallowed coin batteries cause internal chemical burns and can be fatal — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- Incidents/injuries: None reported — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- Remedy: Full refund; write "RECALL" on the charger; contact A2batt for return instructions — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- CPSC URL: cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/A2batt-Recalls-EEMB-Lithium-Coin-Battery-Chargers — **HIGH**
**KC Imports and Exports Mini Laser Pointer Keychains:**
- Units: Approximately 9,600 — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- Product: Laser & LED Light Mini Laser Pointer Keychains, model KKC-6071 — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- Sold: Gas stations, discount stores nationwide, and online at divaatheartsj.com, June 2025 – June 2026, approximately $0.42 per unit — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- Hazard: Button battery accessible to children; packaging lacks required Reese's Law warnings; ingested button batteries cause internal burns — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- Incidents/injuries: None reported — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- Remedy: Full refund; email photo of disposed product to kcimport90058@hotmail.com — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
- CPSC URL: cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/KC-Imports-and-Exports-Recalls-Mini-Laser-Pointer-Keychains — **HIGH**
**Reese's Law context:** Reese's Law (enacted 2022) requires child-resistant packaging and specific warnings on consumer products containing button/coin batteries after multiple child deaths — **HIGH** (CPSC.gov)
research.sources: Sources: CPSC.gov recall pages for both products; ConsumerAffairs Aug 7 2026 recall roundup

research.facts:
AAP + Apple Family Media Plan / iOS 27
**Partnership announcement:** Apple and AAP partnership announced at WWDC, June 8, 2026 — **HIGH** (AAP News, Apple Newsroom)
**Description:** Apple adapting the AAP Family Media Plan into iOS 27 device settings — **HIGH** (AAP News; Apple Newsroom)
**iOS 27 release timeline:** Fall 2026 — **HIGH** (Apple Newsroom; WWDC announcement)
**New feature — Ask to Browse:** Child cannot access any Safari website until a parent approves it — **HIGH** (Apple Newsroom; Appleosophy)
**New feature — Mandatory Child Account:** Child Account required for all users under 13; available for users up to 18 — **HIGH** (Apple Newsroom)
**New feature — Time Allowances:** App usage managed by category — **HIGH** (Apple Newsroom)
**New feature — Contact Approval:** New contacts for a child's device require parent approval first — **HIGH** (Apple Newsroom)
**New feature — Expanded Communication Safety:** Now detects gore and violent content in addition to nudity — **HIGH** (Apple Newsroom)
**AAP Family Media Plan tool:** Free, interactive tool at HealthyChildren.org/MediaUsePlan since 2016 — **HIGH** (AAP HealthyChildren.org)
**Back-to-school timing note:** AAP identifies start of school year as #1 recommended time for families to reset media agreements — **HIGH** (AAP guidance via Standard-Examiner article)
